scope: Development ablation on one H100 node of the 2D Kovasznay full loss and all-parameter gradient (FP64, TF32 off): separate the derivative representation (GL8 consumer state versus complete Q10 jet) from the execution (native CUDA pointwise islands versus Inductor-generated kernels, and compiled versus eager), test the explicit output-state transpose against generic autograd on the same GL8 state, and scale the comparison in interior points, width and depth. All ratios are H100 ratios; none is combined with or compared against the H20 campaign.

source.tree: 263 files, byte-identical to the verified H20 snapshot
source.unchanged: bench_gpu.py, gpu_engine.py, problem.py, solve.py and every flashns module

runtime.native_islands: flashns.vnext.cuda (sm_90, -O3 --fmad=false), prebuilt CPU-only into the batch cache

prior_result: A100 round 2 (2026-09-13, 2,048 interior points): under Inductor + CUDA Graph the compact GL8 state was not faster than compact Q10 (0.58-0.77 ms against 0.43-0.52 ms per full gradient; DEFER_NO_SIGNAL). The expected outcome here is therefore a representation effect near zero or unfavourable to GL8 at 2k points, with most of the H20 solve-level 1.66x coming from execution. Whatever the outcome, it is reported.

A.meaning: complete Q10 jet, Inductor + CUDA Graph

B.meaning: GL8 state with explicit output-state VJP, Inductor + CUDA Graph

C.meaning: same GL8 layout and output-state VJP with native CUDA pointwise islands, CUDA Graph, no compile

D.meaning: complete Q10 jet, eager + CUDA Graph

E.meaning: GL8 explicit output-state VJP, eager + CUDA Graph

F.meaning: same GL8 state with generic parameter autograd, Inductor + CUDA Graph

no_q10_native_cell: There is no native-kernel Q10 backend in this source; the total C/A is decomposed as (B/A) x (C/B).

effects.reading: ratios are baseline time over candidate time; above one favours the second cell

effect_threshold: |ratio - 1| < 0.03 is reported as no effect (the H20 A/A gate); otherwise the direction is reported with its bootstrap interval
uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over process medians, 10,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261016); intervals describe process-to-process variation on one node only

timing.method: unchanged bench_gpu: fresh process per measurement, Q10-oracle full loss/gradient check (atol 2e-12, rtol 2e-11) before timing, 30 replays, 2 s sustained warmup, 7 samples x 100 CUDA Graph replays timed with CUDA events, compile/capture counters unchanged during timing
timing.statistic: median over processes of the per-process median ms per full gradient
timing.excluded: setup, compilation and capture (recorded separately per process)

validity_gates.AA: cell A relabelled A_AA, same tasks: |median(A_AA)/median(A) - 1| < 0.03 at 2k and 16k
validity_gates.drift: the first four core tasks repeated at the end: |repeat/original - 1| < 0.05 for each
validity_gates.oracle: every timed process passes the Q10 oracle; a failed process is reported and excluded from its cell
validity_gates.lanes: four GPUs run concurrently; tasks are pulled from one shared queue in a pre-randomized order and each task's lane is recorded; cell medians per lane are reported

boundary_points: 512 boundary coordinates at every interior count (Problem default)
shape_initialization: problem.parameters(timing_seed) with WIDTHS set to the topology (same initializer and scaling); the parameter byte hash is recorded per task
solves: development only: unchanged solve.py protocol with the 500-block extension, 2,048 interior points; setup and optimization seconds, gradient calls and acceptance per (cell, seed); paired C/A and B/A setup-plus-optimization geometric means; never pooled with H20
profiles: replicate 0 of every core (cell, size) adds bench_gpu's untimed one-replay torch-profiler trace; kernel time is grouped into GEMM (cuBLAS/CUTLASS), native islands, Inductor-generated, reduction, copy and other; whether Inductor kept aten mm (extern cuBLAS) or emitted GEMM templates is recorded from the kernel names
deadline: tasks run in tier order; a task starts only if its estimated duration (1.25 x the longest completed task of the same kind, cell, size and topology, or the protocol default) fits before the batch deadline; skipped tasks are recorded

execution.allocation: one ACC node, four H100 lanes, 3 h, run once; cluster-side driver with embedded start command
execution.reason: about 230 fresh processes of ~1 min each over four lanes, plus 18 short solves

reporting.claims: no cross-device ratio; no formal time-to-accuracy claim (solves are development)

frozen_inputs.source: frozen H20 inputs verified for the earlier H100 preparation (5 data and 6 formal initialization hashes)
